description: Explicit hypothetical production example, not measured site productivity. One existing HT-02 class truck/operator pair; a what-if pool permits up to three if extra pairs are actually obtained. Loading uses EX-01 and competes with retained preparation and drainage. Today's haul draws on the already-completed prior batch, so today's preparation is not a new haul prerequisite. Travel times are scenario assumptions, not inferred from route distance or aerial imagery.
